rows.grounds: compound: vipra+ārādhana (dependent determinative) + mātra, expressing instrument of mere honoring of a brahmin
describes a rite or observance lacking required parts
describes a rite or observance possessing all required parts
asserts the certainty of the result

items.question: Can mere worship of a brahmin render a deficient observance complete?
premises: Mere worship of a brahmin can be performed.
An observance may be deficient in its required parts.
Such worship has the capacity to supply completeness.
items.inference: Therefore, by mere worship of a brahmin, a deficient observance certainly becomes complete.
uncertainties: The specific ritual context of the deficient observance is supplied by the preceding verses.
items.plain_english: By merely honoring a brahmin, what is deficient certainly becomes complete.
